# jFindMe - AI Agent Context Prompt

You are working on **jFindMe**, an enterprise-grade Android location tracking application built with MVVM architecture.

## Project Profile
- **Package**: `com.jdroidx.jfindme`
- **Architecture**: MVVM Enterprise with Engine Registry pattern
- **Languages**: Kotlin (primary), Java (entry point), Python (Chaquopy for GIS)
- **Min SDK**: 26 | **Target SDK**: 34

## Tech Stack
- **Android**: AGP 8.7.3, Kotlin 2.1.0, Material Design 3
- **Backend**: Firebase Realtime DB, Auth, Analytics, Crashlytics
- **Location**: Google Maps SDK, FusedLocationProvider, Geofencing API
- **Data**: SQLite (local) + Firebase RTDB (cloud), Chaquopy Python
- **Architecture**: Engine Registry pattern, Closed-Loop Waterfall

## Key Directories
```
app/src/main/java/com/jdroidx/jfindme/
├── data/         # Repository, Model, Local (SQLite), Remote (Firebase)
├── engine/       # Core engines (sync, location, alert, map, security)
├── service/      # Background services (TrackingService, FCMService)
├── ui/           # Activities, Fragments, ViewModels
│   ├── auth/     # Login/Register flows
│   ├── group/    # Group management UI
│   ├── map/      # Map views and markers
│   └── settings/ # App settings
├── utils/        # Helpers, DeviceIdentity, etc.
└── receiver/     # BroadcastReceivers

app/src/main/python/
└── data_processor.py  # Python GIS functions (Haversine, spatial filters)
```

## Critical Patterns to Follow
1. **Never delete existing code** - update or merge new code
2. **Closed-loop sync**: Local SQLite ↔ Firebase RTDB must stay in sync
3. **Hardware Identity SSOT**: Physical device serial is the single source of truth
4. **RAG Status**: Green (<15m active), Yellow (<6h), Red (>6h), SOS (emergency)
5. **Build quarantine**: Never run gradle builds autonomously
